body_markdown:
The season of Thanksgiving is upon us, bringing the joy of festive feasts with family and friends to celebrate togetherness and blessings big and small. This year, we’re celebrating our community at Lifeway by sharing all our best holidays eats with you, showcasing some of our favorite holiday recipes from our own kitchen. Start preparing now with a little help from us at Lifeway!


Our collection of decadent, delicious holiday recipes blends seasonal flavors with[probiotic-packed ingredients](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/all-products) from Lifeway to support your microbiome, including[Lifeway Kefir](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/what-is-kefir) ,[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) , and[Lifeway Kefir Butter](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewaykefirbutter) .


### Gut-Healthy Substitutions with Lifeway for All Your Holiday Recipes:


Did you know? Lifeway Kefir, Farmer Cheese, and Lifeway Kefir Butter all work beautifully in holiday recipes, whether you need a creamy[whipped topping](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/whipped-farmer-cheese-berry-dip/) made with Lifeway Farmer Cheese, an easy-to-pour creamy liquid using probiotic[Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/family/kefir/) instead of milk, heavy cream, or yogurt, or a rich butter where[Lifeway Kefir Butter](https://lifewaykefir.com/lifeway-probiotic-kefir-butter/) subs easily one-to-one for regular butter. Our probiotic products offer easier digestion compared to regular dairy products due to the fermentation process,[low lactose attribute](https://lifewaykefir.com/why-our-kefir-is-lactose-intolerant-friendly/) , and high-quality, bioavailable nutrients. Ditch the post-meal holiday bloat and serve yourself and loved ones a gut-healthy feast with a little help from Lifeway.


Discover our favorite gut-loving Thanksgiving dishes below!


###


### 1.[Probiotic Turkey Brine](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/turkey-brine/)


Start your Thanksgiving meal preparation by infusing your turkey with probiotics. Lifeway Kefir’s[Turkey Brine recipe](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/turkey-brine/) enhances the brine with live cultures to give it a tender, juicy texture, and it boosts the turkey recipe with natural protein from Lifeway Kefir. You haven’t had a turkey until you’ve had one made with our turkey brine!


### 2.[Probiotic Sourdough Stuffing](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/sourdough-stuffing/)


Upgrade your regular stuffing with our[Probiotic Sourdough Stuffing](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/sourdough-stuffing/) filled with fresh ingredients and a delicious homemade flavor. This classic Thanksgiving dish becomes even more appealing with the addition of our probiotic-rich kefir and it’s filled with veggies full of fiber. This recipe is a must-try!


### 3.[Farmer Cheese-Stuffed Sweet Potatoes](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-stuffed-sweet-potatoes/)


We’ve never met a sweet potato we didn’t love, but our[Farmer Cheese-Stuffed Sweet Potatoes](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-stuffed-sweet-potatoes/) take things to a whole new level. Elevate your table with these nutrient-packed sweet potatoes that are packed with probiotics and natural protein from Lifeway Farmer Cheese.


### 4.[Corn Pudding](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/corn-pudding/)


Our creamy Corn Pudding made with[Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/plain-lowfat-kefir/) and[Farmer Cheese](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/cheese-farmer-cheese/) features a golden, crispy crust that’s beyond inviting. Underneath the baked crust is a luscious layer made with corn and Lifeway Kefir and Farmer Cheese. Similar to corn casseroles that you may already know and love, this[easy corn pudding recipe](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/corn-pudding/) offers a softer, creamier approach that no one will be able to resist.


### 5.[Balsamic Roasted Green Beans](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/balsamic-roasted-green-beans/)


Transform ordinary dinner greens into a centerpiece with these Balsamic Roasted Green Beans served over protein-rich whipped[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) . Savory, crisp-tender green beans are tossed in tangy balsamic vinegar, lightly roasted, and finished with rich melted[Lifeway Salted Kefir Butter](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/salted-kefir-butter/) for an extra layer of decadence.


### 6.[Hot Honey Jalapeño Cornbread](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/hot-honey-jalapeno-cornbread/)


During this season of thanks and holiday festivities, we thought it’d be fun to showcase our[Hot Honey Jalapeño Cornbread](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/hot-honey-jalapeno-cornbread/) as a daring addition to the traditional holiday menu. Easy to make, this recipe features[Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/plain-lowfat-kefir/) in the batter to create a tender, spongy texture that melts in your mouth with a delicate crumb and unbelievable flavor.


### 7.[Garlic Butter Brussels Sprouts](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/garlic-butter-brussels-sprouts/)


When it comes to the Thanksgiving spread, the side dishes always steal the spotlight, and this year, we’re setting a new standard for your holiday table. Say hello to our Garlic Butter Brussels Sprouts elevated with a rich garlic butter sauce made with[Lifeway Salted Kefir Butter.](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/salted-kefir-butter/)


### 8.[Farmer Cheese Stuffed Butternut Squash](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-stuffed-butternut-squash/)


Caramelized, tender butternut squash serves as an edible vessel for a creamy, protein-rich filling made with[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) in this Farmer Cheese Stuffed Butternut Squash recipe. It’s the perfect healthy side dish for your holiday table and packed with probiotics and protein to satisfy and support gut health.


### 9.[Mini Protein Mac and Cheese Cups](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/mini-protein-mac-and-cheese-cups/)


Who says comfort food can’t double as everyday fuel? If your love language is warm and creamy mac and cheese, but you still want to hit your protein goals this Thanksgiving, let us introduce you to our Mini Protein Mac and Cheese Cups. These perfectly portioned cups are packed with flavor and nutrition thanks to Lifeway Farmer Cheese, Lifeway Kefir, and Lifeway Kefir Butter.


### 10.[Spinach and Caramelized Onion Farmer Cheese Pinwheels](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/spinach-and-caramelized-onion-farmer-cheese-pinwheels/)


Meet your new favorite holiday appetizer guaranteed to impress and delight any crowd. Our Spinach and Caramelized Onion Farmer Cheese Pinwheels take everything you love about a classic savory pastry and give it a creamy, protein-packed upgrade that tastes downright decadent.


### 11.[Seeded Fall Pumpkin Bread](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/seeded-fall-pumpkin-bread/)


Our[Seeded Fall Pumpkin Bread](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/seeded-fall-pumpkin-bread/) will make a beautiful addition to any holiday table in place of traditional bread. The addition of seeds and kefir provides a unique texture and a dose of gut-friendly goodness, and it’s delicious served with Lifeway Farmer Cheese and Lifeway’s homemade butter!


### 12.[Kefir Biscuits](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-biscuits/)


For a finishing touch to your holiday feast, our[Kefir Biscuits](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/kefir-biscuits/) are unlike any other biscuit you’ve had. Made with Lifeway Kefir in the batter, these are topped with our homemade kefir butter and taste delicious on their own or with a jam or fruit butter of choice.


###


### 13.[Sweet Potato Biscuits with Cranberry Butter](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/sweet-potato-biscuits-with-cranberry-butter/)


Nothing says homemade like a fresh batch of biscuits, and our Sweet Potato Biscuits with Cranberry Butter made with Lifeway Kefir are our latest favorite! These bright and colorful biscuits are more than eye candy; they’re packed with flavor, nutrients, and have a heavenly texture thanks to[Lifeway Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/products/plain-lowfat-kefir/) used in the batter.


###


### 14.[Probiotic Fall Harvest Butter Board](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/probiotic-fall-harvest-butter-board/)


Forget traditional charcuterie — this Probiotic Fall Harvest Butter Board is ready to be the new crowd favorite. Featuring all three varieties of[Lifeway Kefir Butter](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewaykefirbutter) , this fall-inspired butter board showcases three creative flavor combinations, providing plenty of delicious options to enjoy at your gatherings all season long.


### 15.[Farmer Cheese Cranberry Dip](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/farmer-cheese-cranberry-dip/)


Kiss the boring canned cranberry sauce goodbye, because our Farmer Cheese Cranberry Dip is here to steal the spotlight. This vibrant holiday recipe is packed with protein, live probiotics, and a luscious, creamy texture thanks to[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) . Simplicity meets sweet satisfaction in this dip that doubles as dessert with wellness benefits you’ll love!


### 16.[Butter Pecan Apple Parfaits](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/butter-pecan-apple-parfaits/)


Give everyone a mini dessert they’ll love packed with holiday flavor, protein, and probiotics. Every spoonful of these Butter Pecan Apple Parfaits packs in rich sweetness balanced with nutrients thanks to Lifeway Farmer Cheese and Lifeway Kefir Butter.


### 17.[Gingerbread Bundt Cake with Sugared Cranberries](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/gingerbread-bundt-cake-with-sugared-cranberries/)


One of our latest favorite holiday desserts is our[Gingerbread Bundt Cake with Sugared Cranberries](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/gingerbread-bundt-cake-with-sugared-cranberries/) which offers a towering display of festive gingerbread topped with sugared cranberries that bring color, flavor, and holiday appeal to any dessert table from Thanksgiving all the way through the new year.


### 18.[Pumpkin Spice Soft Serve Frozen Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/pumpkin-spice-soft-serve-frozen-kefir/)


Need a healthy frozen treat to pair with your holiday pie? Try our[Pumpkin Spice Soft Serve Frozen Kefir](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/pumpkin-spice-soft-serve-frozen-kefir/) . Featuring all the seasonal flavor you love with protein and probiotics, this chilly treat is a gut-healthy delight your gut will love as much as you do!


### 19.[Probiotic Pumpkin Mousse Cheesecake](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/probiotic-pumpkin-mousse-cheesecake/)


Craving pumpkin pie and cheesecake at once? Meet our[Probiotic Pumpkin Mousse Cheesecake](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/probiotic-pumpkin-mousse-cheesecake/) made with Lifeway Kefir, Lifeway Farmer Cheese, and Lifeway Kefir Butter. Layered with flavors and satisfying textures from top to bottom, this colorful dessert is sure to be the talk of the table.


### 20.[No Bake Cherry Cheesecake Pie](https://lifewaykefir.com/recipes/no-bake-cherry-cheesecake-pie/)


Serve up a dose of cheer to everyone at your holiday table with a delicious piece of our No Bake Cherry Cheesecake Pie. Made with[Lifeway Farmer Cheese](https://www.lifewaykefir.com/lifewayfarmercheese) and[Lifeway Kefir Butter,](https://lifewaykefir.com/family/butter/) this protein-rich, fruit-filled dessert is sure to satisfy a sweet tooth and end the meal on a gut-healthy note, too.


By incorporating these gut-healthy recipes into your Thanksgiving menu, you not only treat your taste buds but also nurture your gut microbiome. Thank you for joining our holiday celebrations and for letting us help you #LoveYourGuts all year long. Happy Thanksgiving!
